findings.statement: Marketing overspent its budget by 152,200, which is the largest overspend among all departments.
findings.method: SQL join and subtraction to calculate overspend for each department, then ordered by overspend descending
findings.code: SELECT b.department, b.budget, a.actual, (a.actual - b.budget) AS overspend FROM budget_2025_budget b JOIN budget_2025_actual a ON b.department = a.department WHERE a.actual > b.budget ORDER BY overspend DESC
